name: principle-test-behavior-not-implementation
purpose: Keep tests that observe user-visible behavior and catch defects instead of asserting implementation details.
triggers: When writing, changing or keeping a test
inputs: Test code, subject code and observable results
Available file access, test execution and permissions
outputs: Concrete-input assertions against literal output or observable effects
Rewritten or deleted weak tests, with table relation and compile-time checks retained
ordinaryExample: Call slugify with Hello, World! and assert hello-world; confirm that an empty function fails the assertion when execution is available.
capabilityLimits: Missing execution leaves the proposed empty-function check unverified.
Preserve disable-model-invocation metadata without assuming host enforcement.
Host behavior has not been tested.
